scope: Only A12.15 return from the attempted ordinary entry into the board 01 ground-level building after a second SMC or MMC defeats the elected Infantry OVR before entry resolves. The prior read-only consequence is a prerequisite, not execution authority.

coreEffectsFromA1215.scope: The unit is returned from the briefly attempted target to the last occupied Location.

The recorded ordinary 2 MF attempted-entry cost is attributed to the Location returned to; the state contract must distinguish cost recorded from MF already debited to avoid charging twice. Do not infer an additional doubled OVR cost.
A12.15 says the returning mover loses Concealment; the admitted attacker is already unconcealed.
End the mover's MPh after return; no further movement is inferred.

initialExecutionSubset: Return and ordinary attempted-entry MF attribution can be considered only with a confirmed clear return Location (no Residual FP, FFE, minefield, Wire, Depression, entrenchment or shellhole) and no intervening state change. Any unknown or active hazard blocks this subset pending a separately reviewed resolver.

runtimeBoundary.gate: Registered action, authenticated tenant principal, permissions, exact constraints, diagnostics and risk must yield AuthorizedAction; a read-only domain conclusion alone is insufficient.
runtimeBoundary.version: AuthorizedAction.ValidatedStateVersions records checked versions, but the present generic executor does not enforce an ASL aggregate compare-and-swap at the write. An ASL state store must atomically compare the current version and apply all admitted effects or none.
runtimeBoundary.idempotency: The same attempt and authorization must not debit MF twice or replay the return; duplicates yield the previously committed result.
runtimeBoundary.verification: Audit the action and read back the committed version and effects; unverified or partially verified effects do not authorize additional actions.
